known.title: Merge partialIndexes into an existing previewFeatures list

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - generating a feature in a starter app that already enables another Prisma preview feature.
This insertion adds a second `previewFeatures` property when the generator already contains, for example, `previewFeatures = ["relationJoins"]`. That is a supported [Prisma configuration](https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/prisma-client/queries/relation-queries). The command writes an invalid generator block, so subsequent Prisma generation and migration commands fail. Append `partialIndexes` to the existing array, creating the property only when absent.
